propositions: The primary comment deduplication guard (binding_store.is_comment_mapped) was inert from feature launch through first fix because the comment_ids map was never populated on production data.
A secondary body-equality dedup skip silently absorbed traffic and hid the primary guard failure, making the failure appear as partial success rather than complete loss.
Test suite covers both shores of the dedup path but not the seam between transport envelope and recording, allowing all tests to pass while production dedup never engaged end-to-end.
The guard failed silently by design with no logging, raised exception, or metric change, leaving operators no signal that the primary dedup key had been empty.
Review criteria existing at the time of the feature commit abstained on external vendor response schema claims and endpoint-level assumptions, leaving the faulty premise unvetted.
